title: Discount panics with an unknown coupon code
body:
Calling `Discount` with a code that is not in the rates map crashes
instead of leaving the amount alone.

Steps:

```bash
go run ./cmd/shop
```

Output:

```
panic: runtime error: integer divide by zero

goroutine 1 [running]:
example.com/shop/pricing.applyRate(...)
	/home/dana/src/shop/pricing/pricing.go:10
example.com/shop/pricing.Discount(...)
	/home/dana/src/shop/pricing/pricing.go:6
main.main()
	/home/dana/src/shop/cmd/shop/main.go:11 +0x124
exit status 2
```
